    public static int Run(int input)
    {
        var destination = Destinations[input];
        int actual;
        if (Widths[input] == 32)
        {
            var value = BitConverter.Int32BitsToSingle(unchecked((int)Sources[input]));
            actual = Checked[input] ? destination switch
            {
                0 => checked((sbyte)value),
                1 => checked((byte)value),
                2 => checked((short)value),
                3 => checked((ushort)value),
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(input))
            } : destination switch
            {
                0 => unchecked((sbyte)value),
                1 => unchecked((byte)value),
                2 => unchecked((short)value),
                3 => unchecked((ushort)value),
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(input))
            };
        }
        else
        {
            var value = BitConverter.Int64BitsToDouble(unchecked((long)Sources[input]));
            actual = Checked[input] ? destination switch
            {
                0 => checked((sbyte)value),
                1 => checked((byte)value),
                2 => checked((short)value),
                3 => checked((ushort)value),
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(input))
            } : destination switch
            {
                0 => unchecked((sbyte)value),
                1 => unchecked((byte)value),
                2 => unchecked((short)value),
                3 => unchecked((ushort)value),
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(input))
            };
        }
        return actual == Expected[input] ? 42 : -1;
    }
}
